## Encryption
- **Rule:** Traffic is encrypted in transit by the hosting platform (HTTPS) and by the provider SDKs. The app stores no data at rest.
- **Why:** Limits the damage of intercepted traffic.
- **Decision:** No key management service. There is no stored data to encrypt, and visitor keys live only in session memory.
- **Status:** Kept current (doesn't fit the platform). Revisit if the app ever stores data.
